spec.name: Molen — Little Dutch Windmill
spec.description: A chunky Animal Crossing-style Dutch windmill with a cream brick tower, a gallery deck, a coral-red arched door, a fat thatched cap and four lattice sails facing the front.
spec.layout: A squat rounded stone plinth (y 0-0.85) carries a cream-brick tower that tapers gently from radius 1.3 to 0.85 up to y 3.7; the front (+Z) has an arched coral door with a stone step at ground level, a porthole window pair below and a shuttered window pair above. A wooden gallery deck ring wraps the tower at y 2.3-2.62 with a cute post railing. On top sits a fat rounded thatch cap (y 3.7-4.85) like a big muff, with a scalloped fringe, a wooden neck housing poking forward to z 1.15 that holds the sail bearing, a gold ball finial and weathervane at y up to 5.2, and a wooden tail pole sloping down the back to [0, 2.75, -1.7]. The four sails form a big X on the front face: hub at mount sailHub [0, 4.05, 0.75], arms reaching 1.95 m out (sail bottoms at y 2.05, tops at y 6.05), each with cream canvas panels, a coral stripe and gold tips. Everything rests on the plinth at y = 0; shapes are chunky and rounded, every seam, trim, knob and flower is its own small part in a flat palette colour, giving the soft toy-like ACNH look.

parts.builds: Stone plinth and lower tower. Plinth y 0-0.85: a turned lathe profile in stone (stoneShade for the underside foot), radius 1.45 at the ground with a chamfered step at y 0.12 and radius 1.3 at the top, plus 5-6 small rounded stone chunks tucked around its base and a thin stoneShade seam ring at y 0.45. Tower y 0.85-2.0: a cream-brick cylinder (brick) tapering from radius 1.3 to 1.15, with thin brickSeam horizontal rings every ~0.28 m and a few single brickShade patch bricks stuck on for texture; a soft ink outline ring sits right under the top edge at y 1.98. Front face (+Z), all centred on x=0: an arched door 0.72 wide x 1.2 tall with its base on the plinth top — coralRed door leaf with wood plank seams (thin woodDark strips), a creamTrim arch frame with an ink outline, a gold round knob at mid height and a tiny gold hinge plate each side; a small stone step slab (stone, stoneShade top) protruding to z 1.5 under the door. Two round porthole windows at y 1.55, x = +/-0.5, seated on the curved brick: windowGlass disc with a creamTrim ring and a thin ink outline. A little wall lantern right of the door: wood bracket arm, small glass cube in lampGlow with an ink cap and gold ring, glowing warmly. Everything rides millRoot.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor (y = 0). Its top face at y 2.0 is mount towerMid, where towerGallery begins; it builds nothing above y 2.0.

parts.builds: Upper tower and gallery. Tower y 2.0-3.7: cream brick (brick) tapering radius 1.15 to 0.85, continuing the brickSeam ring spacing from below so the seams line up across mount towerMid; a wood beam trim ring (wood, with woodDark edge line) radius 1.17 at y 2.0 caps the joint. Gallery deck at y 2.3-2.62: a circular wooden walkway ring radius 1.38 (wood planks with thin woodDark plank seams and a stoneShade weathered edge), wrapping clear around the tower. Railing on its outer edge: 12 evenly spaced rounded posts (creamTrim) radius 1.32, each 0.34 tall with an ink outline band at the base and a small gold ball finial on the three posts facing front (+Z, within +/-45 deg of front); one continuous creamTrim top rail ring at y 2.98 with a thin ink underside line. Tower face details: a small gallery door on +Z at y 2.7 (coralRed leaf, creamTrim frame, gold knob); two shuttered windows at y 3.15, x = +/-0.45 on the front curve — windowGlass pane in a creamTrim frame with ink outline, shutterGreen shutters swung open flat to each side with two horizontal slat seams and a tiny gold latch each; under each window a little woodDark window box with a leafGreen foliage mound and three round flowerPink blooms and one gold-centred bloom. Everything rides millRoot.
parts.attaches: Bottom face at y 2.0 meets plinthTower at mount towerMid; top face at y 3.7 is mount towerTop where capTail sits. The gallery ring clears the tower surface; nothing else builds on the deck.

parts.builds: Thatched cap, neck and tail pole. Cap y 3.7-4.85: a fat rounded muff (lathe) starting radius 1.02 at y 3.72, swelling to radius 1.08 at y 4.1 then rounding over to a soft dome top at y 4.85 — thatch colour with thatchShade bands on the underside and lower half; a wood cap band (wood, woodDark edge) radius 1.02 at y 3.65-3.75 seats it on mount towerTop. Scalloped fringe around the base edge: 14 small rounded thatch teeth (thatchShade) hanging down ~0.14 like a trim. Front neck housing: chunky wood beams (wood with woodDark corner caps) protruding from the cap front from z 0.7 to z 1.15, centred at mount sailHub, carrying a dark woodDark bearing ring radius 0.16 with a thin gold rim — the sail axle passes through it. Top: a gold lathe finial (ball + small spire) from y 4.85 to 5.2, with a tiny weathervane arrow above it: wood arrow shaft, gold arrowhead and tail fins. Tail pole: a wooden pole (wood) from the cap rear at [0, 4.35, -0.85] sloping down and back to [0, 2.75, -1.7], ending in a rounded woodDark knob, with 4 short ladder rungs (woodDark) spaced along its lower half for a climber's grip. Everything rides capYaw.
parts.attaches: Sits on mount towerTop [0, 3.7, 0] (towerGallery below); its neck housing holds the bearing at mount sailHub [0, 4.05, 0.75] which the sails part builds through. The tail pole hangs outside the gallery railing.

parts.builds: The sail assembly, an X on the front face. Axle: a woodDark rod from [0, 4.05, 0.6] out to z 0.98, passing through the cap's bearing ring at mount sailHub; a chunky rounded hub boss (woodDark, radius 0.24) at z 0.8 with a gold hub cap disc facing +Z and a tiny gold centre stud. Four whip arms at 45, 135, 225 and 315 degrees (so the X is diagonal from the front), each a tapered rod from the hub to length 1.95 (wood, woodDark at the root collar, a small gold tip cap at the outer end). Each arm carries: two cross ribs (woodDark, thin rounded sticks) across it at 0.7 and 1.35 from the hub; a canvas panel — a flat cream slab 0.62 wide x 1.35 long, 0.03 thick, mounted flat against the arm from 0.25 to 1.6 out, canvas colour with a coralRed stripe band near the outer edge, a thin gold trim line along the panel's outer edge and an ink outline around the panel; on the bare outer 0.35 m of the arm, three short leading-board slats (creamTrim) like a classic Dutch sail lattice. All four sails read as one airy X silhouette against the tower. Everything rides sailHub so the whole X can spin.
parts.attaches: The axle seats in the bearing at mount sailHub [0, 4.05, 0.75] built by capTail; sails float in front of towerGallery and capTail, never touching them.
